notes: The smallest tide: two bars in 4/4, a breath in (third, fourth, fifth, held) and a breath out (down by step to the home note). Hymn-like; it says the most when it is said slowly. Summer: F major with the morning lift (a busier answer); the code-built piano leads, a warm string bed, vibraphone touches.
